The packaged checker independently executes finite polynomial, moment, limit and simulation checks; finite computation is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The observable stationary shape near a two-point frozen position has a singular non-Gaussian residual width, so variance-only measurements conceal its internal fluctuation structure. The theorem identifies the exact limiting law and width coefficient, while strict kurtosis monotonicity provides a complete shape-to-exponent and shape/variance-to-reset-rate calibration across the whole physically natural alpha>=0 family. This constitutes a motivated boundary phenomenon and full inverse classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
